components.name: ReSpeaker XVF3800

components.limitations: STEP and 2D drawing are different revisions; exact acoustic port registration and shell sealing require checking. Some supplier solids are not watertight after tessellation. Do not print electronics meshes.

components.name: Camera Module 3 standard
components.fidelity: Confirmed product envelope; simplified lens, PCB, connector and edge cradle
components.limitations: Detailed camera STEP not imported; attachment holes not invented. Edge saddle is a proposal.

components.name: Compute Module 5 + CM5-NANO-B
components.fidelity: CM5 55 x 40 envelope; provisional carrier, connector placements and cooling
components.limitations: 55 x 41 carrier PCB retained from C.02 is provisional, not drawing-verified in C.03. Underside RJ45, USB and mini-HDMI blocks are packing reserves. Board-to-board geometry is indicative; no manufacturer hole pattern or final mating height asserted.

components.name: Waveshare 4inch HDMI LCD (C)
components.fidelity: Nominal active area and provisional board/connector outlines
components.limitations: Retaining clips proposed; board thickness, connector positions, cable exits and fastening not validated.

components.name: Top speaker
components.fidelity: Generic 40 mm driver reserve with conical diaphragm, open basket, magnet and gasket
components.limitations: No commercial driver selected. Acoustic volume, power, impedance and screw pattern unvalidated.

components.name: VL53L1X and light sensor
components.limitations: Carrier dimensions and optical stack need selected-module verification; light module unselected.

components.name: SC09 positional microservo
components.fidelity: Conservative 34 x 16 x 34 mm keep-out, illustrative shaft and clamp; not supplier CAD
components.limitations: Direct supplier retrieval HTTP 403; exact mount/horn dimensions, continuous torque and bus mapping require supplier documentation and bench validation.

components.name: Yaw transmission
components.fidelity: Proposed 72:48 GT2 pulleys, 220 x 6 mm belt; visible teeth are illustrative
components.limitations: Tension adjustment, tooth profile, purchased belt, fasteners and fit not released.

components.name: Head bearing support
components.fidelity: Two 25 x 37 x 7 mm bearing reserves, hollow spindle with 16 mm cable bore, rotating tray and support bridge
components.limitations: Bearing variant, fits, shoulders, retention, load and fatigue not validated.

components.name: Motion power and controller
components.fidelity: PCB and connector reserves for half-duplex TTL controller and regulated 6 V supply
components.limitations: No selected controller or PSU, schematic or executable motor firmware; watchdog, motor enable, supply transients and GPIO mapping remain to implement.

components.name: Joint flex harness
components.fidelity: Illustrative neutral route and viewer twist
components.limitations: No validated lengths, connector engagement, bend radii or torsion life. Bounded ±180° only.
